Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Dear Methuselahs,

The Tremere Chantry invites you and all Vampire players in your area to
come to Vienna and take part in the biggest struggle of Vampires ever:

The European VTES Championships 2000

Up to 100 players from all over Europe will have the opportunity to
compete for the title of the European Champion. For the first time
White Wolf is going to support V:TES on a large scale.

There will be a lot of prizes to win, interesting people to meet and
hard fought games to play. It will be the V:TES event of the millenium!

CONVENTION: Spielefest Vienna 2000 (Vienna Games Festival 2000)

LOCATION: Vienna International Centre, Kaisermuehlen, A-1220 Vienna,
Austria

DATES: Convention 24th-26th of November
EC Welcome Party with Registration: 24th of November, 8pm.
EC Draft and Draft rounds 1-3: 25th of November, 9.30am
EC constructed rounds 1-2 plus overall final: 26th, 9.30am
Awards plus live-show after the final

The EC will consist of 3 rounds of Sabbat War Elder Draft and 2 rounds
of constructed. The best 5 players from all 5 rounds make it to the
final round. To become European Champion requires a lot of skill,
players will have to show their ability to play both draft and
constructed format.

For entry we have to charge you with 22 Euro (300 ATS). But you receive
free entrance to the Convention on both days and get the Boosters for
the Sabbat War draft for free. So there are no additional costs.

For further information you may want to visit the following sites:

http://www.8ung.at/vtes - Information about the European Championships
2000

http://www.spielefest.at - Information about the convention (German!)

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes Official V:TES Site

Please pass this information to as many friends as possible.
I am looking forward to welcome you in my domain,

Alexander Woisetschläger, Prince of Vienna (email: gri...@teleweb.at)

P.S. If you want to bring friends with you, who don`t intend to
participate in the championships, the Games Convention at the Austria
Center welcomes all visitors to have a look at the latest game releases
and try a round with new friends. But anyway, Vienna is always worth
seeing!

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Special Note:

As I understand it, by special arrangement with WW, Sabbat War cards
*will* be allowed in the constructed tournaments rounds (in addition to
being in the Sabbat War draft, obviously), even though the cards don't
become generally available for use in constructed tournaments until Dec.
1st, 2000.

Carl: could you confirm that (and possibly add that information to
the EC web site)? Thanks.

--
